data.name: Quddoos
data.gender_notes: Quddoos is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is honored and respected, close to Allah and pure in heart. The name Quddoos carries the meaning “Honorable, Godly, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Quddoos usually hope their child will grow to embody honorable, godly, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive for purity of heart and actions, seeking closeness to Allah
data.etymology: Quddoos belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honorable, Godly, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quddoos total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: قدوس
in_arabic.meaning: الله تعالی کا نام، مقدس، پاکیزہ،
in_arabic.long_meaning: قدوس اللہ تعالی کا ایک نام ہے جو مقدس، پاکیزہ، اور بے داغ ہونے کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں بہت احترام کے ساتھ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: قدوس
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام، پاکیزگی، مقدسیت،
in_urdu.long_meaning: قدوس اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک صفاتی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے پاکیزہ، مقدس، اور بے داغ۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'ق د س' کی بنیاد پر ہے جس کا مطلب ہے پاک کرنا یا مقدس کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اللہ تعالیٰ کی توصیف کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ुद्दूस
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ुद्दूस ईश्वर का एक नाम है जिसका अर्थ है पवित्र, पवित्रता और पवित्र होने की स्थिति। यह नाम अरबी भाषा की 'क़ द स' मूल से है जिसका अर्थ है पवित्र करना या पवित्रता प्रदान करना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में ईश्वर की विशेषता के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी किया गया है।

in_pashto.name: قدوس
in_pashto.long_meaning: قدوس د الله تعالی یو نوم دی چی د پاکۍ، مقدسیت، او بې داغۍ ښودنه کوی. دا نوم د ق د س په عربي ريښه ولاړ دی چی د پاکولو یا مقدس کولو معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي دود په الله تعالی د توصيف لپاره کارول کېږي او په قرآن کريم کې يې ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.name: Quddoos
in_english.meaning: Holy, Sacred, One of the Names of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Quddoos is one of the Names of Allah, signifying His holiness, sacredness, and freedom from defects. The term originates from the Arabic root 'q-d-s', meaning to sanctify or to be holy. This name is mentioned in the Quran and holds significant importance in Islamic tradition as an attribute of Allah, reflecting purity and transcendence.

While it may not be as common as some other names, it holds a significant place within Islamic culture due to its meaning. The name conveys a sense of respect, honor, and closeness to Allah, reflecting the ideal of striving for purity of heart and behavior. People with the name Quddoos may be seen as spiritual or pious individuals, evoking a feeling of reverence and trust.

It signifies that the individual is known for their purity of heart, a quality highly valued in Islamic teachings. By embracing the name Quddoos, one is reinforcing their commitment to living a life that adheres to God's guidance, fostering a deep sense of reverence and humility while nurturing a closer relationship with the Creator. Ultimately, the name serves as a reminder that seeking Allah's pleasure is the highest form of achievement and fulfillment in life.
